reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes a γ′ (L12) phase forms in Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni, whereas the well-established phase formation in this system is B2 (ordered BCC) and/or BCC, not FCC-based L12, making the core mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and systematic, but it is designed to detect a γ′ phase that is not expected to form, so a negative result would not cleanly falsify the stated mechanism versus a simple phase misidentification.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamental misunderstanding of the Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni phase space, directing research effort toward a non-existent phase rather than the actual BCC/B2 transitions that govern properties.
